The '''Malastarian council''' was one of the two governments of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It governed the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] species while the [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]] represented the planet in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], it ratified the [[Treaty of Malastare/Legends|Treaty of Malastare]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] which allowed the latter access to Malastare's substantial reserves of [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] in return for the elimination of the gargantuan [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]] and Republic protection from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==History==
During the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Malastarian council, led by [[Doge/Legends|Doge]] [[Nakha Urus/Legends|Nakha Urus]], governed the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] species, providing defense and conducting bilateral relations. It is unknown whether the Council represented Malastare in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] since that was occupied by [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Senator/Legends|senators]] from the [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]].<ref name="Gran in the Databank">{{DB|species|gran|Gran}}</ref> During the Clone Wars, Malastare's substantial [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] reserves<ref name="OFEG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]''</ref> caught the attention of the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], which both need the fuel to power their [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. While the Gran Protectorate controlled Malastare's senatorial representation, the Dug-dominated Malastarian Council still retained control of the planet's substantial fuel reserves.<ref name="HolocronKeeper">{{Twitter|HolocronKeeper|status/11946627956|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=@avgoins The fuel reserves are not controlled by the Gran-led planetary government thus the need for a separate treaty with the Dugs.|archivedate=20200329175118}}</ref>

Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SWA-2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> a massive Separatist [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] invaded Malastare. Outnumbered and outgunned, the Malastarian council appealed for the Republic, which dispatched [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] reinforcements. However, the Republic reinforcements and their Dug allies were still outnumbered two-to-one by the larger droid army. When it appeared that the Republic would lose, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] authorized the deployment of the prototype [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] the [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]], which immobilized the droid forces rapidly, wiping out resistance.<ref name="TZB">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast}}</ref>

However, the blast opened a crater and the ensuing uproar stirred a [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]], the last of a gargantuan ancient species that had preyed on the sapient Dug natives in ancient times. The enraged beast emerged from its crater and rampaged through the emaciated Republic and Dug lines, inflicting heavy casualties and much chaos. Fearing an apocalyptic doom, the Malastarian council demanded that the Republic destroy the Zillo beast or they would not ratify the treaty and provide the Republic with fuel.<ref name="TZB" />

[[File:Treaty_of_Malastare.png|thumb|left|250px|The fuel treaty is signed]]
Believing that this would lead to the death of an innocent life form, Windu refused but was overruled by Palpatine who publicly agreed to destroy the monster. However, he and Skywalker secretly arranged to immobilize the beast and have it transported to an undisclosed [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world for scientific research. Using several [[RX-200 Falchion-class assault tank/Legends|stun tanks]], the Jedi incapacitated the beast with an energy beam that knocked it unconscious, making it appear to be dead.<ref name="TZB" />

With both the Separatists and the Zillo Beast eliminated, the Council convened and granted permission for the Republic to use Malastare's fuel reserves to power its expanded [[Republic Navy/Legends|star fleet]] which was engaged against Separatist forces across the span of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TZB" /> In reality, the Zillo Beast was not dead but had been shipped to the galactic capital [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to be studied under a contained environment following a change of plans.<ref name="TZB" /><ref name="ZBS">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast Strikes Back}}</ref> Still, the treaty afforded Malastare's place as a key Republic member-world throughout the Clone Wars and the subsequent [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Malastarian council was first introduced in "[[The Zillo Beast]]," an episode in the [[2009]]-[[2010|10]] [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]]. It confirmed Malastare's role as a key Republic member world during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. However, the episode's portrayal of a governing Dug administration capable of providing defense and conducting foreign relations contradicts several other sources which place the immigrant [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] and the [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]] as the de facto government of Malastare. These sources also stated that the dominant Gran disenfranchised and stripped the indigenous Dugs of political power.<ref name="Gran in the Databank" /><ref name="Galaxy Guide 12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref><ref name="TNEGTAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> This problem is retconned away by [[Leland Chee]]'s explanation that the Dug-dominated Malastarian council rather than the Gran Protectorate controlled Malastare's fuel resources, thus explaining the need for a separate treaty with the Republic.<ref name="HolocronKeeper" />
